hero.headline2: Get an answer you can trust.

features.title: One companion, four jobs
features.advisoryDesc: Speak or type your crop problem, get a diagnosis and next step.
features.diseaseDesc: Photograph a leaf, get a likely disease and treatment path.
features.productsDesc: Browse CIB&RC-registered products by crop, category, and region.
features.counterfeitDesc: Scan a batch code before you buy or apply anything.

how.title: How it works
how.step1Desc: Describe the problem out loud, or photograph the affected crop.
how.step2Desc: FAR[M]ATE checks the diagnosis against registered products.
how.step3Desc: Follow a dosage and safety guide built for that exact product.

index.title: Verified Product Index
index.subtitle: A live look at what's registered, in one place.

footer.disclaimer: FAR[M]ATE is a prototype built for hackathon challenge SH-AGR-002. Advisory content is informational and does not replace guidance from a licensed agronomist or your local Krishi Vigyan Kendra.
